name: Tropical Paradise Getaway
description: Experience the ultimate tropical vacation with crystal-clear waters, white sandy beaches, and world-class diving. This 7-day package includes luxury accommodations, daily breakfast, and access to exclusive snorkeling and diving sites.

name: Adventure Diving Expedition
description: Perfect for diving enthusiasts! Explore multiple reef sites, encounter diverse marine life, and enjoy professional diving instruction. Package includes all diving equipment, guided tours, and comfortable beachfront accommodations.

name: Luxury Island Retreat
description: Indulge in a premium 10-day island experience featuring private beach access, spa treatments, gourmet dining, and exclusive excursions. This all-inclusive package offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure in a stunning tropical setting.
